question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the equation given below to make the following equation correct?

10 + 4 - 5 × 2 = 19
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and numbers respectively:

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) Signs × and-, Numbers 5 and 4

10 + 4 - 5 × 2 = 19 ⇒ 10 + 5 × 4 - 2 = 19

⇒ 10 + __**5 × 4**__ - 2 = 19

⇒ __**10 + 20**__ - 2 = 19

⇒ __**30 - 2**__ = 19

⇒ 28 ≠ 19 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) Signs - and +, Numbers 10 and 5

10 + 4 - 5 × 2 = 19 ⇒ 5 - 4 + 10 × 2 = 19

⇒ 5 - 4 + __**10 **____**×**____** 2**__ = 19

⇒ __**5 + 20**__ - 4 = 19

⇒ __**2**____**5 - 4**__ = 19

⇒ 21 ≠ 19 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) Signs × and +, Numbers 2 and 4

10 + 4 - 5 × 2 = 19 ⇒ 10 × 2 - 5 + 4 = 19

⇒ __**10 × 2**__ - 5 + 4 = 19

⇒ __**20 + 4**__ - 5 = 19

⇒ __**24 - 5**__ = 19

**⇒ 19 = 19 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 4) Signs + and -, Numbers 10 and 2

10 + 4 - 5 × 2 = 19 ⇒ 2 - 4 + 5 × 10 = 19

⇒ 2 - 4 + __**5 × 10**__ = 19

⇒ __**2 + 50**__ - 4 = 19

⇒ __**52 - 4**__ = 19

⇒ 48 ≠ 19 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
